decision: Drop of 50 grid positions for the next Race in which the driver participates.
fact: The following Power Unit elements have been used: 5th Engine (ICE) 5th Turbocharger (TC) 4th Energy Store (ES) 4th Control Electronics Unit (PU-CE) 4th MGU-K
offence: Breaches of Article B8.2.2 (read with Article B8.2.3) of the FIA F1 Regulations.
penalty: Drop of 50 grid positions for the next Race in which the driver participates.
reason: The penalty is imposed in accordance with Article B8.2.8 of the FIA F1 Regulations. Subject to Car 77 being classified in the results of Qualifying, Car 77 will be allocated a grid position in the Race in accordance with Article B2.5.4b.iv of the FIA F1 Regulations.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
